name: FFS_ACTION_LINK_PARAMETER
description: Contains parameters for custom action links.

columns.name: PARAMETER_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier of the parameter record.

columns.name: ACTION_LINK_ID
columns.description: Identifies the action link this parameter belongs to.

columns.name: FIELD
columns.description: Name of a standard field this parameter defines a default value for. Or, if this parameter is related to a custom property, the 'property' string is stored in this field.

columns.name: PROPERTY_ID
columns.description: Identifier of a custom property this parameter defines default value for.

columns.name: VALUE
columns.description: It is the value to pass to the action handing script.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.
